description: This file contains the Java class ImageTransform, which provides utility services for image processing such as loading images, scaling them, and parsing related XML configuration files within the Apache Ofbiz framework.

classes.name: ImageTransform
classes.description: Provides static utility methods for image manipulation such as loading, scaling, and converting images, as well as parsing related XML configuration files.

methods.name: getBufferedImage
methods.description: Loads an image from a specified file location and returns a map containing the BufferedImage and response message.

methods.name: scaleImage
methods.description: Scales a BufferedImage according to specified dimensions fetched from a configuration map, returning a scaled image and scale factor.

methods.name: getXMLValue
methods.description: Parses the specified XML file to extract configuration values into a map.

methods.name: toBufferedImage
methods.description: Converts a generic Image object to a BufferedImage object, with an overload that specifies image type.
